ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a pair of similar pentagons. Above the larger blue figure on the left is labeled the corresponding length 35 cm, and below the figure is labeled the area A = 1050 cm². Above the smaller green figure on the right is labeled the corresponding length 28 cm. The problem asks to find the area of the green figure. Reasoning: The area ratio of similar figures equals the square of the ratio of corresponding side lengths. The linear scale of the green figure relative to the blue figure is 28/35 = 4/5. Therefore the area of the green figure = 1050 × (4/5)^2 = 1050 × 16/25 = 672. Final answer: 672 cm².
